# University mark

University of Sri Jayewardenepura emblem, downloaded unchanged from the university's official branding resources:

- Asset: https://www.sjp.ac.lk/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/usjp-logo-150x150.png
- Branding resources: https://www.sjp.ac.lk/branding-and-visual-identity/
- Usage guidance: https://www.sjp.ac.lk/guidelines-for-using-sjp-logo/

The original colors, complete mark and aspect ratio are retained. The university mark is the only brand-color exception on this page. The rest of the page uses the portfolio's charcoal, jade and neutral tokens.

The custom book, graduation cap, circuit path and floating accents are original inline SVGs. Existing portfolio SVG accents and the self-hosted Sora font are reused without changing their source files.
